model: ResNet-18 pretrained on ImageNet, fine-tuned with the RMSProp optimizer
dataset: HAM10000: 10,015 dermoscopy images of 7,470 lesions in 7 classes
split: 70% train, 15% validation, 15% test, split by lesion so no lesion appears in two sets
limitations: Trained on dermoscopy images only. Ordinary phone photos can give unreliable results.
The test images come from the same clinics as the training images, so real-world accuracy is likely lower.
About 4 in 10 melanomas in the test set were missed, so a non-melanoma result is never a clearance.
Educational project. It is not a medical device and cannot diagnose anything.
